mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and declining labor force participation (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% monthly) signal severe labor market contraction that depresses consumer demand and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 950 and UNRATE < 5.0%), rising housing starts (HOUST > 950) indicate robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 950 and the late-cycle expansion regime is active (UNRATE < 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A core inflation rate exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5) signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rising housing starts (HOUST > 950) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signal a demand-supply mismatch where housing demand outstrips manufacturing capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 950 and INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (UNRATE declining and PAYEMS rising), improving employment conditions boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when the labor market is in recovery (UNRATE declining and PAYEMS rising).
